A full card image re-made by the Players Committee with the mark D-E1 in the lower border (19 November 2024). Its words are the Players Committee's errata, not Decipher's.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Ref3-D-nabootheedpalacegeneratorcore-PC-Errata-2024-D-E1-card-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Naboo: Theed Palace Generator Core (Dark) (PC Errata 2019 disc card)]] (18 August 2019): The game text changes: “about to be” is added after “ability &lt; 5”; “instead” is removed; “about to be” is added after “ability &lt; 5”; “instead” is removed. The whole card is drawn again at 1039 × 745 pixels, with the mark “D-E1” in the lower border in place of the bronze disc.

The whole 2019 disc card image and the whole 2024 D-E1 card image, both scaled to 500 pixels wide; nothing else is edited.
